msg: At the beginning, choose any gnome and if you are receiving high scores such 4/5 then keep choosing that gnome even if it pops up on the other side. However, as soon as you notice the points dipping cliick the other gnome. It is likely that this one will begin to generate 4/5+ points. Keep using this tactics to get high scores.
